comparison.objective: Extract a locked terminal; record transports a long panel while limiting bow.
comparison.physical_skill: Localized blade insertion and coupled withdrawal versus distributed bimanual support of a bending object.
comparison.success_condition: Selective depinning without damage versus panel lifted and released on a rack with peak bow at or below 3 mm for full credit. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: The record's defining ability is support-point selection under deformation.
